edges.notes: liburing wraps the Linux io_uring uAPI (rings, submission, completion) for C programs.
Targets Linux io_uring syscalls and supported opcodes as documented for the running kernel.
liburing is a C library for building io_uring-based applications.
Typical GNU/Linux builds link liburing against glibc.
musl-based Linux userlands may link liburing.
Clang compiles liburing and its consumers.
GCC compiles liburing and its consumers.
